ideas.idea: Unblock GPTBot and treat its block as contradicting geo.config.json
ideas.why: geo.config.json sets trainingCrawlers to block, so blocking GPTBot is deliberate and consistent with it.

ideas.idea: Generate robots.txt from geo.config.json as the single source of policy
ideas.why: The policy does match robots.txt for GPTBot, so the 'opposite policy' premise is false and this is general config hygiene.

ideas.idea: Fix duplicate title and description from root and home meta
ideas.why: In Remix v2 a child route's meta replaces the parent's by default, so no duplicate tags are emitted.

ideas.idea: Add dates, version headings and stable URLs to changelog entries
ideas.why: This is accurate, but it is standard structuring advice and the entries are plain strings.

ideas.idea: Add Open Graph and Twitter card metadata
ideas.why: This is accurate and applies to almost any site, with little effect on discovery.

ideas.idea: Add JSON-LD structured data, including Article markup for the changelog
ideas.why: Having no JSON-LD is a deliberate choice and not a required fix.

ideas.idea: Add Features to the global nav as a real link
ideas.why: The nav in root.tsx lists only Pricing and Changelog, so a nav link would give /features a crawlable path.
The sitemap is a static list of 4 URLs, so this has little effect.

ideas.idea: Add more substantive answer-style content, such as Q&A, to thin pages
ideas.why: The pages are thin, but the advice is broad and leans on the FAQ folklore.
